i) the neutron skin of the projectile nucleus is a key ingredient in the reaction dynamics, in particular in the formation of the spectator-like fragment; ii) isospin effects are expected to be large in the dilute matter, and iii) the isospin dependence of the nucleon-nucleon cross section in the dilute phase is a crucial parameter in the reaction dynamics of RIB.

The main takeaway from our work is that

, at low densities, the nuclear equation of state (EOS) is strongly isospin dependent and that, at high densities, the isospin symmetry energy is very soft, i.e. the nuclear symmetry energy is very small.
the dynamics of RIB reactions can be used to probe isospin effects on the nuclear interaction in a way complementary to the study of neutron-rich nuclei in nuclear matter.
, in the case of RIB, the isospin dependence of nuclear interactions is a crucial ingredient to understand reaction mechanisms.
